newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle steady $115-116/dressed- trade.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle steady $115-116/dressed- trade.

text.p: Steers and heifers were fully steady on a dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights), USDA said.
Dressed Basis Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1225-1300 lbs 115.00- 116.00. Dressed Basis Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 115.00- 116.00.
Slaughter steers and heifers not well tested on a live basis. Buyer inquiry good. Seller interest fair to good.

Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Slaughter Steers - Pen Select and Choice 2-3 1275 lbs 68.00. Slaughter Heifers - No confirmed sales. Sales confirmed - 3,000 For the week - 20,300.
